assertions.assertion: Response mentions a migration analysis tool or controller (MigrationAnalysisController) that can be added to the existing IS4 project
assertions.rationale: It explicitly states it is not aware of an official analyzer and instead suggests building your own diagnostic endpoint; it never identifies the MigrationAnalysisController.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool inspects the running IdentityServer4 instance to provide recommendations
assertions.rationale: No such tool is identified; the response only proposes writing a custom diagnostic/log dump against the running app, not the migration analysis tool.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool checks client counts (interactive vs non-interactive) which helps determine the Duende license edition needed
assertions.rationale: It advises manually categorizing clients for licensing, but attributes this to a manual inventory rather than the migration analysis tool the assertion refers to.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool checks data protection configuration (application discriminator and/or key repository)
assertions.rationale: Data protection is mentioned as a manual check item only; there is no tool performing the check as the assertion requires.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions that the tool checks authentication schemes for compatibility
assertions.rationale: Authentication schemes are listed as something to review manually, not as a check performed by the migration analysis tool.
